notice: PRESENTATION ONLY. Every animation here is a pure function of (state reported by the state source, the time that state was first observed, the UI clock). None feeds anything back: an animation can never change a state, a number or an order.

animations.description: RESEARCH: a slow halo pulse while research points accumulate.
Stalled research does not move: the dashed ring already says it.
RESEARCH: completion. An expanding ring, then the settled completed state.
A brief shimmer when a node first becomes known.
REALIZATION: a pip fills when a node reaches the next stage.
A single dull flash when a capability degrades.
BUILDING: planned, construction, partial, completed, maturing, mature. A sweep crosses the construction bar.
UNIT: recruiting, training, ready, deployed, experienced. Training pulses.
UNIT: a flash when veterancy rises.
KNOWLEDGE DIFFUSION: source, contact channel, exposure, absorption, local development. Dots travel the pathway. Diffusion is NOT implemented; this only draws a pathway the content declares.
AGE TRANSITION: current Age, transition indication, new Age, settled. A sweep crosses the transition banner while the source reports a pending transition.
AGE TRANSITION: the new Age's icon flashes once, then settles.
